initiatives.name: NorCal Resist
initiatives.description: Volunteer group in Sacramento and Chico, CA. Provides ICE bond help, legal clinics and deportation defense, plus food and diaper distributions, brake light repair clinics and accompaniment.

initiatives.name: Rural SURJ of NorCal
initiatives.description: Rural chapter of Showing Up for Racial Justice (SURJ) organizing white people around racial justice in rural far Northern California.

initiatives.name: Northern California Innocence Project
initiatives.description: A legal group that seeks to exonerate people wrongfully incarcerated by the state.

initiatives.name: Norcal Anti-War Action
initiatives.description: A grassroots organization coordinating anti-war actions and peace initiatives across Northern California.
